verdict.rationale: Proa's own docs say WCAG and WAI-ARIA checks run during cargo build, so accessibility defects are flagged during development without a separate audit tool. This rests on a single marketing-level claim. missing for 10: detailed docs on which accessibility rules are checked and how warnings are reported or configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the checks work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get built-in accessibility warnings during development instead of relying on separate audit tools

citations.quote: WCAG and WAI-ARIA checks run during cargo build so common markup defects fail before deploy.
